method: LightGBM parallel binary classifiers (T1/T2/K1/K2), final: isotonic calibration + causal p>=0.5 selection
selection_rule: fixed p>=0.5, zero tuning, fully causal
notes: Trained fresh -- does not reuse ExpiryMLCorrection/02_parallel_binary_lgbm.py's saved predictions.
Isotonic calibration fit on validation predictions only, then applied unchanged to test -- the original script had no calibration step.

Selection is a fixed p>=0.5 cutoff, matching the transformer's shipped rule -- the original script used a validation-P&L-maximizing threshold search (tune_threshold), already retired from the transformer pipeline for producing unstable results.

Sharpe/Sortino/drawdown are computed from daily-grouped P&L, matching the transformer's methodology -- the original script's Sharpe was computed from trade-level (not daily) returns, a different and incorrect statistic; Sortino and max drawdown were not computed at all.
t1_k2_only restricts to the T1+K2 structural short-D-leg prior, matching the transformer's scope.
